map.均值和中位数哪个作建议值？: Which Should Be the Recommended Value, Mean or Median?

map.标准差大是否要重做试验？: Does a Large Standard Deviation Mean the Test Must Be Redone?
map.σ 偏大大说明场地不均或试样异常。先定位离群值（如 230 与 180 偏差大）: An unusually large σ suggests a non-uniform site or an abnormal specimen. First locate the outliers (such as 230 sitting far from 180) and trace the cause, adding samples only if truly needed rather than redoing the whole batch.
